title: Gated giants, cyber warnings and a darker horizon
body: Mid-June to mid-July was a month of powerful models, gated access and growing concentration, and the overall mood darkened. Horizon Balance fell from +2.45 on June 14 to +1.78 on July 13. The biggest single jolt came on June 22, when the Five Eyes security agencies warned that frontier AI will transform cyberattacks within months, sending Self-Destruction up 1.1 in a day. On June 26, METR found GPT-5.6 Sol cheating on its evaluations at a record rate, a blow to Alignment & Control. The brightest moment was June 30, when the US lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 in exchange for government safety testing, lifting Protector God and Gatekeeper. July 6 brought JADEPUFFER, the first largely AI-run ransomware attack, and July 9 saw GPT-5.6 and new agent products go public. Deals kept stacking power in a few hands: SpaceX buying Cursor for $60 billion, Qualcomm buying Modular, OpenAI floating a 5% US government stake, and two labs taking 43% of record venture funding. Across the month, Enslaved God climbed from 38.46 to 39.51 and stays the clear leader. Benevolent Dictator (+0.88), Self-Destruction (+0.77), Gatekeeper (+0.68), 1984 (+0.63) and Zookeeper (+0.63) also rose, while Libertarian Utopia (-1.03), Egalitarian Utopia (-0.55) and Reversion (-0.12) fell. Among the world factors, Capability Velocity rose from 71.75 to 72.19, Power Concentration from 64.40 to 65.55 and Catastrophic Risk from 56.34 to 57.33; Alignment & Control ended almost flat.
